notes.title: 0.68 update instructions
notes.notes:
Added full screen and resolution options.
Increase initial weapon attack power.

notes.title: Update plans and tell the truth
notes.notes:
To be honest, after resigning in work in April 2023, it was launched in November 2023. So far, for their own reasons, various problems and defects have occurred in the system and procedures. The income now uses the deposit, and there is no money to eat.
This has also led to the fact that the plan to update the content has not been carried out. I found a job again, but the company did not pay the salary. Now I hope to find a job again, and then work part -time to update this game.
The model of this game is very favorite, mild, dark, and no need to study complex systems, leisure and entertainment, and enjoy the stimulus and surprise of every time.
There are also new roles, equipment, skills, levels, and affixes that have not begun.
Hope to start as soon as possible.

notes.title: 0.67 update instructions
notes.notes: Added prompt interface for insufficient equipment level

notes.title: 0.66 update instructions
notes.notes:
The volume control is modified to moderation size.
Added button descriptions for backpack interfaces.

notes.title: 0.65 update instructions
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that caused some players to be unable to load the scene and get stuck in "Scene Construction" and unable to start the game.

notes.title: 0.641 update instructions
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug that the attack determination area of elite monsters and bosses was incorrect.
Fixed two issues where text was not translated.

notes.title: 0.64 update instructions
notes.notes:
Added dark gold equipment, which can only be obtained through synthesis.
The Disintegration and Fire Bomb upgrades will increase lock-on range.

notes.title: 0.63 update instructions
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where some sound effects could not be muted.
But now the UI display is not normal.

notes.title: 0.62 update instructions
notes.notes:
Except for decomposition and fire bombs, other skill upgrades will reduce CD time.
Fire bombs and decomposition skills increase the number of targets during crafting upgrades.

notes.title: 0.61 update instructions
notes.notes:
1.Fixed the bug that 5 legendary equipment could not be synthesized
2. Fix the bug that the space bar cannot be used to quickly synthesize the backpack.

Tips: Keyboard q can quickly switch between backpack and synthetic backpack
The space key can quickly put on and remove equipment

notes.title: Welcome your suggestions for the next update direction.
notes.notes: The game still has many flaws. Please optimize the current ones or update more content. Everyone is welcome to discuss.

notes.title: 0.60 update instructions
notes.notes: Fixed the bug that could not start the game

notes.title: 0.58 update instructions
notes.notes:
The display effect of the equipment quality icon box has been optimized to make it easier to distinguish equipment of different qualities.
Full controller adaptation is also in progress, and some controller buttons can now be supported in-game.

notes.title: Making final adjustments and optimizing game experience, release soon.
notes.notes: After 7 months of development, the game can finally maintain a good experience for a period of time. We will continue to optimize, adjust, and expand the content. I hope this time we won't disappoint you guys!
